accessToken.description: Opaque WhaleU access token. Optional for public content; required for own popup state and acknowledgement. Supplied invalid credentials fail.

get.description: Guest-capable current accepted content in stable source-ID-descending order. campusId is an explicit physical-campus browsing filter; omission means all-browsers only. Reads never acknowledge.

200.description: Current summaries with opaque revision/session/context-bound navigation.

400.description: Strict input validation failed. Unknown/repeated keys and GET bodies are rejected.

401.description: Supplied bearer is invalid, expired or revoked; owner state requires authentication.

403.description: Current account or Safety restriction denies access. No phone/student verification gate.

404.description: ANNOUNCEMENT_NOT_FOUND or CAMPUS_NOT_FOUND. Withdrawn, foreign and missing announcement IDs share the same result.

409.description: DISCOVERY_RESTART_REQUIRED, ANNOUNCEMENT_REVISION_CHANGED or CAMPUS_UNAVAILABLE. Refresh current facts.

413.description: Request exceeds the parser body-size limit.

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: shared account or guest request-IP announcement budget exhausted.

503.description: ANNOUNCEMENTS_UNAVAILABLE or SAFETY_UNAVAILABLE. Missing accepted coverage is not an empty catalog.
